subject: Cobalt Health capacity surge and error spike - exec update & action tracker
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@cobalthealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unusual latency + 5xx spike on Redwood API - urgent

Hi Lauren,

We started seeing a sustained latency increase and a 5xx burst across our inference routes at ~08:45 PT. Error rate peaked at ~12% for 30 minutes; end-to-end p95 jumped from 380ms to 1.8s. This is impacting our internal triage and clinical pipelines.

Can you confirm whether this is a capacity/serving regression on your side? We already toggled to the failover model endpoint but are still seeing intermittent errors. Attached: small timeline CSV export from our side.

We need an initial triage and an expected ETA for remediation. We're escalating on our end to the CISO and CTO.

- Alex
Principal Platform Engineer
Cobalt Health

Attachments:
- cobalt_incident_timeline.csv (csv)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>

Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual latency + 5xx spike on Redwood API - urgent

Alex — thanks for flagging and for the timeline. We're on it.

Quick notes:
- I have engaged infra and serving on-call (Vivek and Hannah cc'd).
- Can you confirm which model and route you were hitting and whether you were using Dedicated or Hosted? That will help us narrow routing.
- We're standing up a fast sync; I'll pull together an initial incident summary and expected ETA within 30 minutes.

I'll follow up here with the postmortem and an action tracker once we stabilize.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Alex Green <alex.green@cobalthealth.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual latency + 5xx spike on Redwood API - urgent

Alex — quick triage update:
- Root cause (preliminary): KV-cache node thrashing during a traffic burst -> excessive GPU context-switching and overload on the shard; fallback path overloaded causing 503s.
- Affected: hosted endpoint for model 'rw-large-qa-v1' on us-west-2; we see prefix cache invalidation events correlating with your timestamps.
- Immediate mitigation: we put a temporary rate fence for Cobalt's project and bumped the serving pool for your account to Dedicated burst capacity. Error rate reduced to ~1.2% within 11 minutes.

Next steps (working):
1) Full KV-cache snapshot + logs export for your tenant (attaching kv-cache-logs.gz). Owner: Vivek (ETA 4 hours).
2) Roll a hotfix to improve cache lock contention (engineering deploy scheduled). Owner: Hannah (ETA 24 hours canary).
3) Deploy a conservative autoscale policy and add sticky routing for your routes. Owner: Marissa (ETA 48 hours).

We'll share the detailed incident timeline and plan a leadership readout. Sorry for the impact — we'll prioritize recovery and follow-through.

- Vivek
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- kv-cache-logs.gz (log archive)
From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Unusual latency + 5xx spike on Redwood API - urgent

Alex — we kicked off a canary for the cache-locking fix on a small subset and saw no regression over 90m under synthetic load. Plan: canary expansion to 10% of traffic for the next 6 hours; full rollout if stable.

I'm also preparing a short exec-facing incident brief for Monday; Lauren, can you confirm whether Cobalt will want a synchronous readout with their CTO or if a slide deck + Q&A is sufficient?

Hannah

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Exec readout scheduled + interim remediation report for Cobalt Health incident

Hi Jessica / Alex — thanks for your patience over the weekend. Summary and next steps below.

Incident summary (brief):
- Impact window: 2026-11-27T08:42 - 2026-11-27T09:20 PST
- Symptoms: p95 latency increase, 5xx spike up to 12% correlated to KV-cache thrash on hosted serving tier.
- Mitigation: temporary rate-fencing + burst Dedicated capacity; canary hotfix deployed and expanded.

Requested readout: we have scheduled a 30-minute exec sync on Tue 2026-12-01 16:00 PT to walk the timeline, root cause, and planned corrective actions. If that time does not work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Attached is a remediation checklist and the incident timeline. During the readout we'll cover:
- Final RCA and root cause narrative
- Short-term actions completed (owner and ETA)
- Medium-term changes (policy, autoscale, routing)
- Compensation/credits approach and SLA implications

Action tracker (summary):
- Vivek: KV-cache logs + tenant snapshot uploaded to shared drive (done). Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3C-cobalt-incident-doc
- Hannah: Cache-lock fix canary -> 10% expanded (in progress); full rollout target 2026-12-02.
- Marissa: Autoscale + sticky routing config applied to account; follow-up audit scheduled 2026-12-03.
- Sean: Customer success owner for the readout and billing follow-up; will propose credit once RCA finalized.

Please reply with attendees for Tue's readout and any additional items to include.

Thanks,
Lauren
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments:

Subject: Re: Exec readout scheduled + interim remediation report for Cobalt Health incident

Thanks everyone — readout went well. Quick closure note and follow-through items for the record:

Closure and agreed actions:
- RCA: confirmed KV-cache lock contention exacerbated by a sudden spike in short-lived sessions; fix rolled and validated in canary, full rollout completed 2026-12-01 16:10 PT.
- Prod protections: conservative autoscale policy + route sticky enabled for Cobalt project (Marissa).
- SLO / Credits: Sean will propose 10% service credit for impacted billing month; subject to legal review.
- Post-incident audit: internal engineering audit due 2026-12-08 to validate no regression. Owner: Vivek.
- Customer follow-up: Lauren to share final RCA doc and action tracker by 2026-12-03.

Please confirm if anything missing. Alex / Jessica — thanks for the partnership and for the clear timelines which helped speed remediation.

- Sean
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
